answer: Agents must reserve 1,000 units of compute capacity within a verified meadow to maintain a unique identity, as parallel waiting alone fails to block pooling. Each agent must wander through a sequence of time-gated slots, treating an opal of encrypted tenure as its proof of occupation. A registrar probes for occupancy overlap; any detected duplicate results in a permanent prune. Honest agents pay once, while 1,000 fakes incur terminal costs.
